verdicts.decision_note: The client establishes an implementation-relevant rule to revise the test-ad script using keywords that support a viral style.
First concrete draft failure: the reviewed script used an indirect approach and did not apply suitable reference-video keywords.
The client changes the script rule to require keywords selected from the supplied reference videos for the Indian-market ad.
The client narrows the keyword sources to the first and final reference videos and requires the replacement script to be built around them.
The client replaces the keyword source with the last reference script and adds concrete wording constraints requiring distinctive, stronger, non-generic copy.
Target-specific implementation claim: the freelancer reports rebuilding the concept with a defined set of keywords after the requested rewrite.
Post-claim failure: the client finds the proposed keyword set too generic and inconsistent with the required reference-derived wording.
The client changes the script vocabulary by identifying required keyword examples, prohibited generic terms, and authoritative reference sources.
The client revises the vocabulary constraint to require confidence and stamina while retaining the need for additional reference-derived keywords.
Target-specific implementation claim: the freelancer reports extracting concrete Hindi keywords and pain-point wording from the reference videos.
The client adds an explicit script-copy prohibition against using the word लिंग; the false value is a meaningful current wording constraint.
